title: All That Is in the Heavens and All That Is in the Earth
overview: Sitara, a young slave girl, is sold to a family of scholars, where she begins her journey of knowledge.

title: The Roses That Bloom in Safar
overview: As nomads sack the city of Tun, Fatima and Sitara hide in the basement and wait for the others to return.

title: An Undying Flame
overview: Sitara teams up with an unexpected ally in hopes of reclaiming Fatima's book that was stolen by the Mongols.

title: Otchigin
overview: Sitara begins tutoring Sorghaghtani in Euclid's Elements, and learns more about Prince Tolui, the Otchigin.

title: A Snake Shows Its Colors, Man Hides His Colors
overview: Sitara agrees to serve as Sorghaghtani's spy, but her plans to infiltrate Chagatai's court quickly go awry.

title: The Mergen People
overview: Töregene tells the tale of her life among the Merkits, a confederation of tribes renowned for their archery.

title: Brothers
overview: As the Mongol Empire prepares to wage war to the east, Sitara begins to plant the seeds of political intrigue.

title: Great Khatun Boraqchin
overview: After a misunderstanding, Sitara finds herself before the sickly Boraqchin, chief empress of the Mongols.

title: Tengri
overview: Ögedei and Tolui launch their offensive to take the Jin capital Kaifeng, but tragedy strikes soon after.

title: Wisdom
overview: Tolui meets a shocking fate, and Sitara receives an unexpected item that shakes her to the core of her being.

title: An Ungraceful Stone
overview: Six years in the past, Boraqchin encounters a stone with mysterious properties that would change her life.
